item.title: Gibraltar alum Stillman enjoys golden experience at Olympics
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- When Jack Hughes scored on Canadian goaltender Jordan Binnington to win Team USA's first gold medal in men's ice hockey since the 1980 Miracle on Ice, it was the walk-off moment Gibraltar alum Brandon Stillman had hoped after rearranging his flight home.

item.title: Citywide Sturgeon Bay Garage Sale Returns in Early June
item.description: Adam Collins -- The annual Sturgeon Bay City Wide Garage Sale will return June 5 and 6, offering residents and bargain hunters a chance to kick off the summer season with one of the community's longest-running traditions.

item.title: Gustafson Announces Long-Awaited Purves Lagoon Road Repairs
item.description: Adam Collins -- Road reconstruction work is expected to begin later this spring in the Purves Lagoon neighborhood, bringing long-awaited improvements to aging streets affected by past high water levels.

item.title: Buy now, pay later services piling up fees for consumers
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Credit cards are not the only way to buy things now and risk getting burned later.

item.title: Egg Harbor fire causes $100,000 in damage
item.description: Tim Kowols -- A fire in the fitness room of an Egg Harbor resort caused a multi-agency response and an estimated $100,000 in damage Tuesday morning.

item.title: Southern Door High School Student Council Hosts Community Blood Drive
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Student Council at Southern Door High School is partnering with the American Red Cross to host a community blood drive on Thursday.

item.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe statue tour to stop in Champion
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A connection between the continent's only Church-approved Marian apparitions will be formed next month when a life-sized Pilgrim Mother Statue of Our Lady of Guadalupe takes up residence at the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion, located near the Brown-Kewaunee county line.

item.title: Duck Race, Donation Wheel Highlight YMCA Day of Giving
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County YMCA will host its annual Day of Giving on Tuesday, March 3, raising funds to support scholarship programs and expand access to services across the county.

item.title: Your Story Could Be Part of Door County History
item.description: Adam Collins -- As the Door County Historical Society celebrates 100 years of preserving local history, the organization is inviting residents across the peninsula to help shape a landmark centennial project.

item.title: City Holds Meeting on Bradley Lake and Sunset Park
item.description: Adam Collins -- Sturgeon Bay officials met at City Hall Wednesday afternoon to discuss the future of Bradley Lake and the surrounding parkland during a scheduled committee meeting.
